what: Photo and video plates are laid out in a 20 × 8 grid that wraps endlessly in every direction by wheel or drag (WebGL). Plate width is one grid cell, spacing between plates is cell width plus two gaps, and height is ×1.33 for portrait plates, ×1 for square and ×.66 for landscape. At first they overlap in black and white, transparent and enlarged 1.5×, with an 8px gap, then appear at random between .5~1.25s over 2s (power3.out), the enlargement releases over 2s from 1.25s, and the color returns over 2s from 2.25s — meanwhile from 1.5s the gaps open to their real spacing over 2s power4.inOut and the camera descends from +200 over 2s from 1.3s. Wheel adds pixel delta × .05 and drag adds × .1 (finger × .3) to the velocity, which cools by .95 every frame, and while dragging the camera moves closer from 500 → 475. Pressing a plate brings it to the center (1.75s power3.inOut) while the other plates vanish and the camera goes in to 166.7 — arrows move to a neighboring plate (1s), and Esc, an empty spot or the wheel exits (2s)

options.fly: Camera distance when opening the panel, default 166.67
options.fly-dur: Flight duration to the panel (sec), default 1.75
options.wait: Wait (seconds) before the loading cells fill, default 1.2
options.label: Text to send as fx:crosshair when a hand rests on the panel for .2s, default VIEW
options.open: Text sent to the cursor when it hovers an open panel (has data-href), default OPEN URL
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One image (hidden) — data-format=portrait|square|landscape · data-label · data-tone=dark|mid · data-video (video slot: the bar below fills every 4s and cycles) · data-href (pressing the open panel again opens a new tab)
options.[data-fx-part=loader]: (optional) 8px loading cell in the center — one fill element inside
options.[data-fx-part=hint]: (Optional) ”Move with arrow keys” hint shown when the panel opens
options.Event: fx:fly-grid-gl { open, index, href } — When opening and closing the panel

note: Drag and wheel are this part’s job, so the wheel over the board does not scroll the page — use it as a board covering one screen. The original reshuffles randomly each time so the same image never neighbors itself (6000 optimization passes) — the part uses a fixed layout, shifting 5 cells per column and 7 per row. On phones (under 768) the original shows a 2-column list instead of this board.

from.where: playground.html — original Playground Gallery·AnimateGallery·Raycasting (gridRowsSize 8, gridColsSize 20, speedMultiplier .05, decay .95, cameraZoomedIn 475)
